notes: Implementation differences for review: SigmoidIMD accepts this static 12500 LP fee and leaves it at 1.25%; its 0.30% LP override applies only to dynamic-fee pools. The hook adds a surcharge of min(150 * priceImpactPips, 897000) pips of the absolute unspecified-currency swap delta, so this pool does not implement the requested 0.30% base and the advertised 90% total-fee cap cannot be inferred from that surcharge cap. The surcharge is paid in the swap's unspecified ERC-20 currency (output for exact input, input for exact output), which can be the launch token; it is not converted to IMD or ETH. This manifest uses the assignment's required IMD pair and pool terms from This launch. DeploySigmoid.run separately targets Robinhood Chain 4663 and a different IMD address; that script's configuration does not match this manifest. Constructor arguments are poolManager_, pairCurrency_, treasury_ in order. The unnamed immutable treasury resolves to $owner; the hook has no administrative owner or switches. beforeInitialize, beforeSwap, afterSwap and unlockCallback accept only the PoolManager. Initialization accepts any caller through the manager, requires the configured pair and another ERC-20, reads that token from the PoolKey, and records its supply-based cap, opening block and settled price. There are no token, factory or launch-number constructor parameters. Hook address permission bits must equal 0x20c4. During blocks creation through creation+99, swaps exceeding 25% price movement from the last settled price revert, cumulative net token purchases are capped at 0.5% of the supply read at initialization, and swaps must be at least 3 blocks apart. Limits are keyed by tx.origin per pool, so users sharing a bundler share limits. These protections end at creation+100; the surcharge continues. Fees go directly to the immutable treasury when the manager has sufficient currency, otherwise the hook holds ERC-6909 claims redeemable to that treasury through permissionless sweepFees. SigmoidToken has no constructor arguments. SigmoidLaunchpad separately deploys FixedSupplyERC20 tokens, opens dynamic-fee pools with this hook at spacing 60, and seeds token-only liquidity in a caller-selected range. Its principal is permanently locked and creators collect LP fees; its dynamic-fee pool creation does not implement this manifest's static-fee launch. The initialPrice field is the required reference value; the deployer derives the actual opening price from the separately versioned launch policy.
